column1: [Bash Environment Variables]  How do you make locally assigned variables accessible to child processes?
column2: use `export variable_name` to export the variable to subshells and child processes.

column1: [Bash Environment Variables] Can a child script or subshell modify or set an environment variable in its parent shell process?
column2: No, process environment inheritance in Linux is unidirectional—parent processes pass variables to children, but child processes cannot modify the parent's environment.
